mapper.insert: replace into t_eastmoney_node_avg(`_date`,`_stockCode`,`last`,`avg_5`,`avg_10`,`avg_20`,`avg_60`) with tmp_stocks as ( select distinct t._stockCode from t_eastmoney_node_9_vol t where t._date in (select max(t1._date) from t_eastmoney_node_9_vol t1 where t1._date <= #{calcDate}) ) , tmp_avg60 as ( select stockCode , avg(case when date_rn <= 5 then LAST else null end) avg_5 , avg(case when date_rn <= 10 then LAST else null end) avg_10 , avg(case when date_rn <= 20 then LAST else null end) avg_20 , avg(case when date_rn <= 60 then LAST else null end) avg_60 , max(tt.`date` ) date , max(case when date_rn > 60 then `date` else null end) min_date from ( select ten.* , rank() over (partition by ten.stockCode order by ten.`date` desc) date_rn from t_eastmoney_node ten, tmp_stocks t2 where ten.stockCode = t2._stockCode and ten.`date` >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(STR_TO_DATE(#{calcDate}, '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 120 DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') and ten.`date` <= #{calcDate} and ten.`date` not like '9999%' ) tt -- where date_rn <= 60 group by stockCode ) -- replace into t_eastmoney_node_avg(`date`,`stockCode`,`last`,`avg_5``avg_10`,`avg_20`,`avg_60`) select ten.`date`, ten.`stockCode`, ten.`last` , round(avg.avg_5, 3) , round(avg.avg_10, 3) , round(avg.avg_20, 3) , round(avg.avg_60, 3) from tmp_avg60 avg, t_eastmoney_node ten where avg.stockCode = ten.stockCode and avg.min_date is not null and ten.`date` = avg.`date` and ( (ten.`last` between avg.avg_60 * 0.975 and avg.avg_60 * 1.025 and ten.`low` between avg.avg_60 * 0.99 and avg.avg_60 * 1.01 and avg.avg_60 < least(avg.avg_5, avg.avg_10, avg.avg_20) ) or (ten.`last` between avg.avg_20 * 0.975 and avg.avg_20 * 1.025 and ten.`low` between avg.avg_20 * 0.99 and avg.avg_20 * 1.01 and avg.avg_20 < least(avg.avg_5, avg.avg_10) ) ) -- and ten.`last` * 1.02 > avg.avg_20 -- and ten.`last` * 0.98 < avg.avg_20 -- and ten.`low` * 1.01 > avg.avg_20 -- and avg.avg_20 * 1.02 < least(avg.avg_5, avg.avg_10) and ten.`last` < 60 order by 1

mapper.insert: replace into t_eastmoney_node_9_vol(`_stockCode`,`_date`,`min_vol_date`,`min_vol`,`min_chg`,`max_vol_date`,`max_vol`,`max_chg`) with tmp_ as( select t.stockCode, t.`date` , t.volume, t.last, t.chg , rank() over(partition by t.stockCode order by case when t.zf_ratio < 10 then t.volume else 99999999999 end, t.date desc) vol_min_rank , rank() over(partition by t.stockCode order by case when t.chg < 3 then 0 else t.volume end desc, t.date desc) vol_max_rank from ( select ten.stockCode , ten.`date` , ten.chg , round((GREATEST(ten.`last`/(1+ten.chg/100), ten.high) / least(ten.`last`/(1+ten.chg/100), ten.low) - 1) * 100) zf_ratio , ten.`last` , ten.high , ten.low , ten.volume from t_eastmoney_node ten where ten.`date` >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(STR_TO_DATE(#{calcDate} , '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 90 DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') and ten.`date` <= #{calcDate} and DATE not like '9999%' and ten.stockCode not like '0.68%' and ten.stockCode not like '0.30%' and ten.stockCode not like '1.68%' and ten.stockCode not like '1.30%' and ten.last < 80 ) t ) select t1.stockCode , t3.max_date , t1.date min_vol_date, t1.volume min_vol, t1.chg min_chg , t2.date max_vol_date, t2.volume max_vol, t2.chg max_chg from (select stockCode, `date` , chg, volume from tmp_ where vol_min_rank = 1) t1, (select stockCode, `date` , chg, volume, last from tmp_ where vol_max_rank = 1) t2, (select max(`date`) max_date from tmp_ ) t3 where t1.stockCode = t2.stockCode and t2.volume > 9 * t1.volume
